title: Number of Good Pairs
summary: For an array of integers, count the pairs where the elements are equal and the first index is less than the second.
statement: For an array of integers, count the pairs where the elements are equal and the first index is less than the second.
constraints: A good pair has indices i<j and equal values.
Return the total number of good pairs.
hints: Count how often each value occurs.
A value appearing c times contributes c choose 2 pairs.
Each good pair belongs to exactly one value bucket and every two indices in that bucket form one pair.
editorial: Each good pair belongs to exactly one value bucket and every two indices in that bucket form one pair.

tests.explanation: Value one contributes three pairs and value three contributes one, totaling four.
Four equal occurrences choose two indices in six ways.
